name.zh: 黑铁一辉VS绫辻绚濑选拔战

periods.summary: Ayase uses illegal Reppu Soukon traps against Ikki, but he defeats her while proving she has not truly abandoned her dignity.
periods.cause: The selection committee pairs Ikki and Ayase; Ayase must win to keep her path to Kuraudo, while Ikki wants to save his friend from self-betrayal.
periods.process: Ayase has pre-cut invisible wounds in the arena air and triggers vacuum slashes as Ikki moves. Ikki already told Oreki and asked her not to stop the match. He deliberately tests Ayase through sword contact, confirms her guilt and hesitation disturb her technique, then uses a single burst of released magic and Shinkirou to bypass her trap timing.
periods.outcome: Ikki strikes Ayase in fantasy form; her body can still move, but her spirit cannot continue the dishonorable fight, so she concedes.
periods.aftermath: Ikki asks what Kuraudo took, offers help, and Ayase finally asks him to save her. She later self-reports her cheating and is suspended/disqualified.
periods.significance: Restores Ayase's self-awareness and shows Ikki's refusal to discard a friend even after betrayal.
